descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S20 Existing api specs: an AI text call retries (Haiku twice, then Mistral) before it gives up, and the pre-round call logs the AI's own time and the model that answered

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Save Note timing: panels within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10 cycles (a target, not pass/fail; a run over 30 s not caused by the AI service is investigated). … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Local backend, diagnostics cleared; chat() with bedrock.invoke stubbed: Haiku throttles twice and Mistral answers, and a run where all three attempts fail

When Call each AI action kind, parsing.parsePreRoundNotes included; ask once through the stubbed router

Then Calls go Haiku, Haiku, Mistral; the answer comes from Mistral with fellBackFrom Haiku; when all fail the error is thrown only after the third attempt; the parsePreRoundNotes row has providerMs (a number) and durationMs >= providerMs, and the log names the answering model

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright api assertions. This is the shared chat() router and its logging; it does not show parsePreRoundNotes' own retry loop, a hanging model (S27) or what the physician sees during the retries (Q10). Merged from the former S13 and S20

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S20

Existing api specs: an AI text call retries (Haiku twice, then Mistral) before it gives up, and the pre-round call logs the AI's own time and the model that answered

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-10.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/ai-call-timing.spec.ts [api] — every kind of AI call item 7 names logs the vendor's time — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-01 primary answers (twin): a Haiku throttle is retried on Haiku once, then answered by Mistral — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-03-04 both fail — expected
  • api/provider-fallback.spec.ts [api] — PF-04-01 log shows the answering model — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api specs e2e/api/provider-fallback.spec.ts and e2e/api/ai-call-timing.spec.ts): the first stubs chat() in-process, the second signs in the local fixture user DEMO_USER through e2e/support/backend.ts; dev has no such user, no admin key and no stub, so they run on the local stack onl…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
